title: 5.6 Proving Triangle Congruence by ASA and AAS

icans: I can use ASA to decide whether triangles are congruent.
I can use AAS to decide whether triangles are congruent.
I can tell which combinations of parts do not prove congruence.

vocab: the side between two angles of a ___________
two angles and the ___________ side of one triangle congruent to two angles and the included side of another

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Discovery: two angles and a side

blocks.p: Draw a 6 cm segment with a 40° angle at one end and a 70° angle at the other. Then draw any triangle with angles 40°, 70°, 70°.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: ASA Congruence Theorem: if two angles and the _______________ side of one triangle are congruent to two angles and the included side of a second triangle, then the triangles are congruent.

blocks.stem: ∠A ≅ ∠D, A̅B̅ ≅ D̅E̅, and ∠B ≅ ∠E. Are △ABC and △DEF congruent? Which theorem?

notes: AAS Congruence Theorem: if two angles and a _______________ side of one triangle are congruent to two angles and the corresponding non-included side of a second triangle, then the triangles are congruent.

blocks.stem: ∠A ≅ ∠D, ∠B ≅ ∠E, and B̅C̅ ≅ E̅F̅. Are △ABC and △DEF congruent? Which theorem?

notes: Not tests: AAA and SSA do _______________ prove triangles congruent.

blocks.stem:
Which theorem, if any, proves the triangles congruent?
a.  all three pairs of angles congruent
b.  two pairs of sides and a non-included pair of angles congruent
c.  two pairs of angles and the included pair of sides congruent
A surveyor measures the angles at two points on shore and the distance between those points. Why does that fix the triangle (and the distance across the lake)?
In △PQR and △XYZ: ∠P ≅ ∠X, ∠Q ≅ ∠Y, and P̅R̅ ≅ X̅Z̅. Which theorem proves them congruent?
∠ABD ≅ ∠CBD and ∠ADB ≅ ∠CDB, and the triangles share B̅D̅. Which theorem proves △ABD ≅ △CBD?

tickets.stem: Two angles and the included side are congruent. Which theorem?
Do three pairs of congruent angles prove two triangles congruent?
